sentences.en: This increase in unemployment is a consequence of the recession.
sentences.zh: 这次失业率上升是经济衰退的结果。

sentences.en: My business is at a standstill because of the recession.
sentences.zh: 由于经济衰退，我的生意停滞不前。

sentences.en: The unemployment rate went up to 5% because of the recession.
sentences.zh: 因为经济衰退，失业率上升到了5%。
